svg.title: Classic GLV loop logic and behavior
svg.desc: Accepted GLV split, initialization, repeated affine helper calls, formula preconditions, required loop invariant, and final low-bit corrections. Dashed connectors show mathematical requirements and proof obligations.

g.text: Classic GLV loop logic and behavior
Correct group result for every input in the stated domain and every accepted witness.
Includes zero scalars, infinity O, and exceptional point relations.
Every helper receives finite inputs with nonzero affine denominators, for every accepted scalar split.
The decomposition relation alone does not establish this invariant.
Incomplete internal formulas require an invariant covering every accepted witness.
